messages:
Aisha (People Ops): Heads up — we're kicking off a short "Lite Privacy + SOC2 evidence" pulse for all product and infra teams. Goal: collect required evidence artifacts and complete the 10‑minute privacy microtraining by 2026-04-10. Full details + upload links below.

Sam (Infra): Thanks — can you list exactly which evidence types infra needs to drop?

Aisha (People Ops): Good Q. For infra we need: access review screenshots, service account inventory export, network ACL attestation (signed), and the short privacy attestation form. Template + example screenshots here: https://redwood.internal/docs/compliance/evidence-2026 :link: 

Jonah (Security): Note — for services using shared GPUs, include a statement about model data isolation (one paragraph) or a link to the design doc. That satisfies the SOC2 scoping evidence.

Elena (Legal): Also confirm any third‑party subprocessors used in the last 12 months. For anything new, please attach the vendor SLA or DSAR handling note.

Mika (Contractor Manager): Do contractors need to take the microtraining too? We have ~8 active contractors across eng infra.

Aisha (People Ops): Yes — contractors must complete the microtraining and their manager must upload the confirmation (screenshot from training LMS). If you're unable to get screenshots, use the contractor attestation CSV we provided and attach it to the evidence folder.

Priya (Platform): Where should teams put their artifacts? Google Drive? Confluence?

Aisha (People Ops): Upload to the centralized evidence folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1-compliance-2026-evidence (use the path <team>/soc2-lite/). Also add a one‑line entry to the tracker sheet (link on the same page). If you need a shared folder ACL please ping me.

compliance-bot: Reminder queued — teams without uploads by 2026-04-03 will get a follow-up nudge. :bell:

Sam (Infra): Quick one — is a scheduled access review export in CSV enough or do you need an admin UI screenshot?

Jonah (Security): CSV export + a one-sentence note on what was reviewed is fine. Keep the CSV trimmed to columns: principal, role, last_active.

Elena (Legal): If you redacted any user identifiers, add a short note explaining redaction method.

Priya (Platform): Asking for a short extension for Platform — we have a release freeze 2026-04-08..12 that blocks one owner. Can we get until 2026-04-14?

Aisha (People Ops): Extensions granted sparingly. Please file the exception form: https://redwood.internal/forms/compliance-exception with manager approval. If approved, we’ll mark Platform as extended to 2026-04-14.

Luis (CTO): Managers — please cascade to ICs. This is lightweight but important for our SOC2 posture. Thanks to People Ops and Security for the clear templates. :raised_hands:

Mika (Contractor Manager): Uploaded the contractor CSV for infra contractors just now. Lmk if anything else needed.

Aisha (People Ops): Got it, Mika — confirmed receipt.

Jonah (Security): For audit readiness: if teams want a quick pre-check, drop a note in #eng-security with the drive link and we'll do a 15‑minute review during office hours. Office hours: 2026-04-05 14:00-16:00 PT.

Aisha (People Ops): Final reminder: training link is here (10 min): https://lms.redwood.internal/courses/lite-privacy-2026 — completion + artifact upload due 2026-04-10. Questions -> ping me or @jonah. :eyes:
